items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in this context; the interviewer mentions seeing Winston Churchill in a picture in Sarah Churchill's apartment.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he had a way of always remarking, like if you’d start something or do something that caught his ear, he’d go, “oh no, no” or something like that. It was weird. It was kind of strange but it was wonderful once we understood. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

And we were sitting at the piano and starting to relax a little bit, and we did about six, seven songs, and I keep looking at this picture in front of me on the piano. And I look and look, and it’s Winston Churchill and his wife, and someone standing behind them — his daughter Sarah. So we were in Sarah Churchill’s apartment, because Alec Wilder knew her and Rogers Brackett knew her, and we could use the apartment to meet Alec while she was out of town. I said, wow, seeing Winston Churchill and Alec at the same…
